bias.en: Rebound · above the 5-day, MACD crossed up
bias.zh: 反弹 · 站上 5 日均线，MACD 上穿

read.en: MP Materials rose 6.6% on Nov 9 to $37.75, trading $35.10–38.06. It is above the falling 5-day average ($36.13) but below the falling 10-day ($38.21), 30-day ($41.37), 100-day ($48.54) and 200-day ($54.27). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 9, still below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 3 ($40.97), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: MP Materials 11月9日上涨 6.6%，收于 $37.75，盘中区间 $35.10–38.06。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$36.13）上方，但仍在下行的 10 日（$38.21）、30 日（$41.37）、100 日（$48.54）和 200 日均线（$54.27）下方。MACD 于 11月9日上穿信号线，仍在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月3日起看空（$40.97），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The close cleared the $35.56–36.55 zone (Nov 4 low, 5-day, Nov 5 high), now support, and the $37.11 Oct 23 low, but stopped just under the $37.81 Jul 29 low. Resistance is $37.8–38.2 (Jul 29 low, 10-day), then $38.96 and $41.0–41.4 (SAR, 30-day). Support is $35.6–36.6, then $33.8 and $31.9 (52-week low). A close above $38.21 would target $39–41; below $35.56, $33.8.

s.en: 5-day average $36.13; Nov 4 low $35.56; Nov 5 high $36.55, cleared
